description: New York physician Joel Fleischman arrives in Cicely determined to escape his four-year Alaska obligation, only to find the town's eccentric residents, unfamiliar customs and Maggie O'Connell steadily undermining his certainty that civilization exists somewhere else.

s01e01.description: New York doctor Joel Fleischman arrives in Alaska expecting Anchorage and instead learns his state-sponsored service will be spent as Cicely's reluctant sole physician.

s01e02.description: Joel treats Ed's seriously ill medicine-man uncle while trading accusations of helplessness with Maggie, as Chris loses his radio job over an on-air reading.

s01e03.description: A hermit's death leaves Joel and Maggie joint owners of valuable land, forcing them to choose between profit, preservation and the wishes of local Native buyers.

s01e04.description: Shelly's apparent pregnancy pushes Holling toward a wedding he fears, while Maurice courts Japanese investors with visions of a Cicely resort and golf course.

s01e05.description: Elaine's visit is wrecked when flu sweeps through Cicely, leaving Joel helpless until Marilyn produces an effective Native remedy she refuses to commercialize.

s01e06.description: Shelly's old husband arrives seeking a divorce, Rick worries about Maggie's supposed boyfriend curse, and Ed finally finds a subject for his stalled screenplay.

s01e07.description: Maurice tries to mold Chris into an heir, Holling pursues the bear that once nearly killed him, and Joel's childbirth class turns unexpectedly practical.

s01e08.description: The northern lights intensify Cicely's dreams as Joel encounters the legendary hermit Adam and Chris discovers an uncanny connection with wandering motorcyclist Bernard.
